**Contribution of moisture stress** 
- Train on non-moisture stress period and test on moisture stress period - the difference (residual) between the observed and predicted GPP is the effect that soil moisture stress has on predictability

1. Define wet and dry seasons (precipitation threshold)
2. Predictors - VPD, Tair, SW rad and LAI
3. Train on unstressed period 
4. Predict on dry season and calculate residuals
Check model actually fits wel, a low R-squared means the model isn't capturing GPP even under good conditions, so the dry season residuals won't actually be meaningful
